messages:
Noah: Weekend check-in: whos doing something fun Sat? thinking of a tiny road trip to the coast or just backyard hammock all day. :ocean: :hammock:
Ivy: Road trip sounds amazing. ETA? I can bring snacks and the bluetooth speaker. :car: :chipmunk:
Rina: Backyard hammock if theres iced tea and chill vibes. Also low-key allergic to sand so coast is a no-go for me. :tea: :sneezing_face:
Theo: Up for the coast if we leave around 8am. Low-key want to catch the tidepool creatures. But if it's hammock day I volunteer for book recommendations.
Noah: OK quick straw poll: reply with "coast" or "hammock".
Ivy: coast
Rina: hammock
Theo: coast
Noah: leaning coast 2-1. If anyone needs a ride I have 2 seats. Packed trunk space: surfboard-ish gear allowed.
cat-bot: Friendly reminder: please secure all pets before leaving the office plants near the window; catnip attracts sir Whiskers.
Ivy: Also there's a random farmers' market in Shorepoint on Sat 10-2 if anyone wants to swing by on the way back. Theo, want me to pick up a blanket?
Theo: yes please. Also, whos bringing sunscreen? I have SPF 50 but only one bottle.
Rina: I can bring aloe for post-sun care and a small first-aid kit.
Noah: Great. Meet at the main lobby at 7:45 for coffee, we'll roll at 8. Bringing spare towels and a thermos of cold brew.
Ivy: pumped. ETA on the playlist? :headphones:
Noah: I'll throw a collaborative playlist link in the thread tomorrow.
Rina: tagging all of you 1: DM me if you want to bring food that needs to be kept cool, I have a small cooler.
Theo: also, if someone wants to stop for breakfast en route, theres that little diner on Route 9 that opens at 6:30. Highly recommend the pancake stack.
Ivy: pancakes + tidepools = bliss. See you Saturday! :wave:
__notes: Slack thread messages concatenated into one string, chronological order, prefixed with sender display names.
